en: Hi, everyone.

en: How are you?

speaker: Unknown
en: All right.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 今天,我想分享我担任首席 AI 官这个职位的经验。

en: I get a lot of questions about it.

speaker: Unknown
en: So to get started, I just would like to get an idea about the folks around here.
zh: 那么,作为开场,我想先了解一下在座各位的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many are in companies that build and sell software products?

speaker: Unknown
en: All right, great.
zh: 好,很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And how many folks have someone leading AI that is not the CEO or the CTO?
zh: 又有多少人的公司里,负责领导 AI 的人不是 CEO 或 CTO?

speaker: Unknown
en: All right, very cool.
zh: 好,非常棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we'll jump right in.
zh: 那我们直接进入正题。

speaker: Unknown
en: This helps.
zh: 这很有帮助。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, like I was mentioning, this role is new, but it's becoming more and more popular, and what I found is that it means drastically different things based on two criteria.
zh: 就像我刚才提到的,这个职位很新,但它正变得越来越流行,而我发现,根据两个标准,它的含义会有天壤之别。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is the company, the type of company you're working for, and two is the level of AI maturity of that company.
zh: 一个是公司,也就是你所服务的公司类型;另一个是这家公司的 AI 成熟度。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's also another dimension, which really is depending on the skill set and the background of the person in the role.
zh: 还有另一个维度,这真的取决于担任这个职位的人的技能组合和背景。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've seen that also vary a lot.
zh: 我也看到这方面的差异非常大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in some cases, the role was created for a particular person that brings a particular skill set.
zh: 在某些情况下,这个职位是为某个拥有特定技能组合的特定人选而设立的。

speaker: Unknown
en: In other cases, there was a very specific need, and people hired in for it.
zh: 在另一些情况下,是存在非常具体的需求,然后为此招人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we'll see, because it's so hard to hire for this role specifically, we'll also see that there's a lot of
zh: 所以我们会看到,正因为专门为这个职位招人非常困难,在招聘这个职位的公司里,也存在很多

speaker: Unknown
en: Open-mindedness in the companies that are recruiting for it for exactly what the person might do based on the person they find and how well that fits and if they can complement it.
zh: 开放性,即根据他们找到的人、契合度如何、以及能否形成互补,来灵活决定这个人具体做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I've also seen it sometimes breaking into two.
zh: 所以我也见过这个职位有时被拆分成两个的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the really interesting things is you see like even these IBM studies one year apart.
zh: 但真正有趣的是,你能看到,即便是 IBM 这些相隔一年的研究也是如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it was like 11% in 2024, 26% in 25, and now 76%.

speaker: Unknown
en: So the tricky thing about this role is, like, it's so great, okay, I have an AI officer, but there's AI in everything, right?
zh: 所以这个职位的棘手之处在于,比如说,太好了,我有一位 AI 官,但 AI 无处不在,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: It's kind of like saying digital or, I don't know, electricity.
zh: 这有点像在说数字化,或者说,我不知道,电力。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's in everything and it can be so many things and it can be really overwhelming, right?
zh: 它存在于一切事物之中,它可以成为很多东西,这可能会让人非常不知所措,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So you have to have a lot of discipline to do it well and to still have joy and not to get overwhelmed and overloaded.
zh: 所以你必须有很强的自律性,才能把它做好,才能保持乐趣,而不是被压垮、超负荷。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how can we do that?
zh: 那我们该怎么做呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: So in my experience, it's been about breaking it into three focus areas.
zh: 就我的经验而言,关键在于把它拆解成三个重点领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: I use the word scientist, architect, and coach.
zh: 我用的词是:科学家、架构师和教练。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll explain a little more.
zh: 我再多解释一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: So scientist is more you're exploring, you're experimenting, you're building.
zh: 科学家,更多是指你在探索、你在实验、你在构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: Architect, you're also building, but you're also doing a lot more strategy.
zh: 架构师,你也在构建,但你还在做更多的战略工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: If the company is selling software product, you're really thinking about creating new software, you're impacting the product strategy.
zh: 如果公司销售软件产品,那你真的是在思考创造新软件,你在影响产品战略。

speaker: Unknown
en: If the company doesn't build software product, you're adding AI in ways that affect not only the bottom line and cost stakeout and productivity, but also the top line in terms of new revenue streams or getting to new markets and so on.
zh: 如果公司不构建软件产品,那你是在以各种方式把 AI 加进去,这些方式不仅影响利润线、成本削减和生产效率,还影响营收线,比如新的收入来源或进入新市场等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm putting also, there is one piece that is quite important here.
zh: 我还要加上一点,这里有一个相当重要的部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So like I'm in a board-facing role, right?
zh: 就像我是一个面向董事会的角色,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So I have to report out to our board in both this company and the previous one I was in.
zh: 所以我必须向我们的董事会汇报,无论是在这家公司还是在我之前的上一家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so for that, there's also part of the job that's like responsibility for what we're doing in AI and how that is helping the company and our customers.
zh: 因此,这份工作中还有一部分,就是对我们在 AI 方面正在做的事情,以及它如何帮助公司和我们的客户负起责任。

speaker: Unknown
en: And finally for Coach, Coach wanted to surprise me.
zh: 最后是教练这个角色。教练这个角色让我挺意外的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had spent 20 years in IBM Research, running about a third of the global research AI organization, and when I took my first job in this role, I forgot that you have to really spend a lot of time
zh: 我曾在 IBM 研究院待了 20 年,管理着全球研究 AI 组织的大约三分之一,而当我接下这个角色的第一份工作时,我忘了你真的必须花大量时间

speaker: Unknown
en: Evangelizing, educating, sharing, over-communicating about what you're doing, about how AI can help, about ways people can adopt it, not only to your employees, but also to your customers.
zh: 去布道、教育、分享、过度沟通你在做的事情,关于 AI 能如何提供帮助,关于人们可以采用它的方式,不仅是对你的员工,还有对你的客户。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now in this role, I also spend a lot of time as trusted advisor to many of our customers, so people in my role at other customers or CTOs that are starting to adopt AI, right?
zh: 而现在在这个职位上,我还花大量时间担任我们许多客户的可信顾问,比如在其他客户公司担任同样职位的人,或者刚开始采用 AI 的 CTO,对吧?

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: That happens later downstream if they're interested.

speaker: Unknown
en: My discussions are always, what problems are you having?

en: This is how we think about the problem.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I have no slides, but that's okay.

speaker: Unknown
en: Does it come back?

en: Well, while you fix it, I'll say a few more words.

speaker: Unknown
en: Right?
zh: 对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So the conversation I have with them is more of a trusted advisor.
zh: 所以我和他们的对话更像是值得信赖的顾问。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I understand what problems they're having.
zh: 就是说，我理解他们遇到的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I see if our technology fits.

speaker: Unknown
en: If our stuff doesn't fit, I might direct them to another thing that works much better for them and where they are.

speaker: Unknown
en: And sometimes they'll come back or they'll just want to have a discussion again.
zh: 有时候他们会回来，或者只是想再次进行讨论。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have many products that are also not AI first.
zh: 我们有许多产品也并不是 AI 优先的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I might talk to some customers that don't use any of our AI capability, right?

speaker: Unknown
en: But they want to think about what they could do in the future.

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So for the scientists, like even at one set, you don't have to have a PhD, you're just exploring heavily.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think there's a way around that because the tech is moving so fast.

speaker: Unknown
en: But on the other end is like the creator-inventor side of the house.

speaker: Unknown

zh: 以及我们如何把这些东西注入到他们已有的流程中？

speaker: Unknown
en: In some cases, there was more invention for the gene discovery part, but in other places, it was just about basic operations.
zh: 在某些情况下，基因发现那部分有更多的发明创造，但在其他地方，就只是基础运营。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for example, the scientists had a hypothesis that if you measure the size of the embryo, of the corn embryo, that is an indicator of how likely, the size was an indicator of how likely you are for the next step to be successful in your gene editing, but it was too costly for humans to do it, right?
zh: 比如说，科学家们有一个假设，如果你测量玉米胚的大小，胚的大小是下一步基因编辑成功可能性的指标，但让人类来做这件事成本太高了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So they say, oh, Rania, please, can we use AI?
zh: 所以他们说，哦，Rania，拜托，我们能不能用 AI？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I did my master's in computer vision, so I looked at that.
zh: 我读硕士时学的是计算机视觉，所以我去看了那个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, well, yeah, sure, we can use AI, but you just need like blob detection.
zh: 我说，嗯，对，当然，我们可以用 AI，但你只需要斑点检测之类的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't need any machine learning, right?
zh: 你不需要任何机器学习，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: You just need basic computer vision.
zh: 你只需要基础计算机视觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we use a very simple algorithm, and it worked really well, right?
zh: 我们用了一个非常简单的算法，效果非常好，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And that helped.
zh: 这起了作用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then in the other case for gene discovery, we did some very interesting with BERT and things like this.
zh: 然后在另一个基因发现的案例里，我们用 BERT 之类的东西做了一些非常有趣的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is a bit like I was trying to put it a bit on a grid of how do we think about it and really in my view with my experience having been like at IBM and at the biotech startup and now at WSO2 those are the dimensions I think about, right?
zh: 所以这有点像，我试图把它放到一个网格里，思考我们该如何看待这件事，而且凭我在 IBM、在生物科技创业公司、现在在 WSO2 的经历，在我看来这些就是我所思考的维度，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like does the company sell software?
zh: 比如，这家公司是否售卖软件？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is the population mainly technical?
zh: 人员构成是否主要是技术人员？

speaker: Unknown
en: And where are you in your AI journey?
zh: 以及你在 AI 旅程的哪个阶段？

speaker: Unknown
en: So I get asked a lot what I measure.
zh: 所以经常有人问我衡量什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Someone asked me to measure tokens to see how much AI we do, and I said no, because it's so easily hackable.
zh: 有人让我衡量 token 来看我们用了多少 AI，我说不，因为它太容易被操纵了。

speaker: Unknown
en: OK, it's easy to measure it, but I didn't want to.
zh: 好吧，衡量它很容易，但我不想那么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they asked me, what do you measure instead?
zh: 所以他们问我，那你衡量什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, okay, these are the things I look at.
zh: 我说，好，这些是我关注的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: AI fluency of the workforce.
zh: 员工队伍的 AI 素养。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, is it only a few people that know AI in a center of excellence?
zh: 比如，是否只有少数人懂 AI，聚在一个卓越中心里？

speaker: Unknown
en: And anytime anyone has to do anything, you have to get those people?
zh: 任何人要做任何事情，都得去找那些人？

speaker: Unknown
en: Are there builders across the functions, right?
zh: 还是各个职能部门都有构建者，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Are there people who know how to do enough to get their job done and to really augment it that are, you know, in marketing, in different engineering teams, et cetera?
zh: 是否有懂得足够多、能完成自己工作并真正增强它的人，分布在市场部、不同的工程团队等等？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or again, are you holding all of those?
zh: 还是说，又是你把所有这些都攥在手里？

speaker: Unknown
en: Now I have a small central AI team that kind of works with everybody, but I have an AI lead in every single product, and every product team has folks working on the AI capabilities in it, right?
zh: 现在我有一个小型的中央 AI 团队，大概和所有人协作，但每一个产品里我都设有一位 AI 负责人，每个产品团队都有人在做其中的 AI 能力，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we have some products that are AI first, right?
zh: 然后我们有一些产品是 AI 优先的，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So everybody there is working on AI.
zh: 所以那里的每个人都在做 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: Level of adoption, I think, matters.
zh: 采用程度，我认为，很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, are you just doing a simple task, cleaning an email, code completion?
zh: 比如，你只是在做简单任务吗，清理邮件、代码补全？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or are you changing an entire workflow for a better outcome?
zh: 还是为了更好的结果而改变整个工作流程?

speaker: Unknown
en: Or, like, we have a couple of our teams that have put agentic employees, right?
zh: 或者说,比如,我们有几个团队已经配备了智能体员工,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So you have these agents that you can instantiate, and they work alongside the team, right?
zh: 也就是说你可以实例化这些智能体,它们和团队一起工作,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's a spectrum.
zh: 所以这是一个光谱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And different teams are in different parts of the spectrum.
zh: 不同的团队处于光谱的不同位置。

speaker: Unknown
en: Tool availability, like have you as a company, have you subscribed to some tools and are you reimbursing or paying the cost with team or enterprise accounts?
zh: 工具可用性,比如作为一家公司,你是否订阅了一些工具,你是否在报销或用团队账户或企业账户支付费用?

speaker: Unknown
en: And then geo visibility, so just as generative engine optimization, right?
zh: 然后是 geo 可见性,就像生成式引擎优化一样,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Can LLMs find us?
zh: LLM 能找到我们吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Can they know what we do?
zh: 它们知道我们是做什么的吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Someone searches.
zh: 有人搜索的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a lot going on there.
zh: 这里面有很多事情要做。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're still working on that, I think, with a lot of other people.
zh: 我觉得我们还在和其他很多人一起研究这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not so straightforward.
zh: 这不是那么直接明了的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's where also someone just yesterday, right, they're like, the web has become for agents, like, it's unreadable for humans anymore because everything's being written, assuming an LLM is reading it and it's so frustrating.
zh: 这也是昨天有人说的,对吧,他说,网页已经变成给智能体看的了,对人类来说已经不可读了,因为所有东西都是假设 LLM 会去读而写的,这太让人沮丧了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's like, so I'm just going to have my LLMs read and summarize for me and I'm only going to talk to humans from now on, right?
zh: 他说,所以我打算让我的 LLM 替我阅读和总结,从今以后我只和人类交流,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: For software products, in the beginning, when I started in this role, it was about what should we build, what should we extend, and where should we partner?
zh: 对于软件产品,在我刚开始担任这个职位的时候,关键是我们应该构建什么、应该扩展什么、应该在哪里合作?

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we wanted all our products to be agent and LLM consumable.
zh: 然后我们希望我们所有的产品都能被智能体和 LLM 消费。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the docs need to be LLM consumable.
zh: 所以文档需要能被 LLM 消费。

speaker: Unknown
en: Last year, we added first-class support for agents, LLMs, and tools to all our products.
zh: 去年,我们为我们所有的产品添加了对智能体、LLM 和工具的一等支持。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this year, we're making sure every product can be used by agents.
zh: 今年,我们要确保每个产品都能被智能体使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So everything needs to have an MCP server and skills and CLI, et cetera.
zh: 所以每个东西都需要有 MCP server、skills 和 CLI 等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agent-proof pricing, so we've all heard this whole SaaS is dead, and if you price per seed and whatever, what happens when the agents come and blow it out of the water, the consumption, so our pricing is all consumption-based.
zh: 智能体防备型定价,我们都听说过 SaaS 已死这种说法,如果你按席位定价之类的,那当智能体来了、把消费量彻底打爆的时候会发生什么,所以我们的定价全是基于消费量的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then dog-footing our stack, I heard another interesting thing today about that.
zh: 然后是自用我们自己的技术栈,今天我还听到了一件关于这方面的有趣的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Somebody told me, like, oh, I met so-and-so company, which I won't name, and they make us use our product, and it would be great, except nobody takes any feedback, right, to make the product better.
zh: 有人告诉我,比如,哦,我遇到了某某公司,我就不点名了,他们让我们使用他们的产品,这本应是件好事,但没有任何人接收任何反馈来改进产品,对吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: So hopefully we close the feedback loop and not only make people use our stuff, but they use it if they like it and if it helps them.
zh: 所以希望我们能闭环反馈流程,不仅让人们使用我们的东西,而且是在他们喜欢、并且产品对他们有帮助的时候使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the third dimension is the market and ecosystem.
zh: 然后第三个维度是市场和生态系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: So AI thought leadership is not about like articles you can pay for, but do you have earned media, which is are you invited for talks?
zh: 所以 AI 思想领导力不是指那种你可以花钱买的文章,而是你有没有赢得的媒体曝光,也就是你是否受邀做演讲?

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you have publications?
zh: 你有出版物吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you showing up in the press because you're doing something?
zh: 你是否因为你做了某件事而出现在媒体报道中?

speaker: Unknown
en: Interesting for real, right?
zh: 是真的有趣的事,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Analyst recognition, customer adoption and use cases is, I think, very, very important, right?
zh: 分析师认可、客户采用和使用案例,我觉得这非常非常的重要,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I stay up a lot thinking about what hurts for my customers and how we can make it better.
zh: 比如,我经常熬夜思考我的客户的痛点是什么,以及我们如何能让它变得更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are a fully open source company, so everything we do is 100% open source, it's not open core.
zh: 我们是一家完全开源的公司,所以我们做的一切都是 100% 开源的,不是 open core。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so for us also, that's a really important signal, right?
zh: 所以对我们来说,这也是一个非常重要的信号,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Community participation and adoption and stars and forks.
zh: 社区参与度和采用度,以及 star 和 fork 数。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then finally, ARR from AI products, right?
zh: 最后是来自 AI 产品的 ARR,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Some of our AI products are very new, so there isn't a lot of ARR, but some of these other things can give signal to it as we get off the ground.
zh: 我们的一些 AI 产品非常新,所以还没有很多 ARR,但在起步阶段,其他这些指标可以提供信号。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also, I think revenue is not the only number that matters, like tokens is not the only number that matters.
zh: 而且,我觉得收入不是唯一重要的数字,比如 token 数也不是唯一重要的数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is, and I think what you measure should change over time based on what you're doing and what your company is doing, right?
zh: 所以这个,我觉得你衡量什么应该随着时间变化,基于你在做什么、你的公司在做什么,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So for me, this is what I'm measuring now.
zh: 对我来说,这就是我现在在衡量的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once these things like reach maturity, I will change this list of things, right?
zh: 等这些东西成熟了,我会改变这个清单,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: But think a lot about it because you really get what you measure.
zh: 但要好好思考这个问题,因为你衡量什么就会得到什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: You start measuring something, everyone's going to optimize for that.
zh: 你一旦开始衡量某个东西,所有人都会为它去优化。

speaker: Unknown
en: So just a few words about WSO2.
zh: 简单说几句 WSO2。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're about 20 years old.
zh: 我们成立大约 20 年了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're about 150 million in ARR.
zh: 我们的 ARR 大约是 1.5 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our software powers a lot of capability in over 90 countries in six continents.
zh: 我们的软件为六大洲 90 多个国家的众多能力提供支撑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our main products, our history has been in API platforms, integration platforms, identity and access management, and internal developer platform.
zh: 我们的主要产品,我们的历史一直在 API 平台、集成平台、身份与访问管理以及内部开发者平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a product for that.
zh: 我们有一个对应的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in the last couple of years since I came, we've added agent identity and AI gateway to govern your AI interactions.
zh: 在我来的最近几年里,我们增加了智能体身份和 AI 网关,用于治理你的 AI 交互。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've added an agent builder to our integration platform.
zh: 我们在我们的集成平台上添加了一个智能体构建器。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's what we do.
zh: 所以这就是我们所做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And everything we do is open source.
zh: 而且我们做的所有东西都是开源的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is our whole portfolio today.
zh: 这就是我们今天的全部产品组合。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you'll see on the bottom, the four platforms, this is what existed like some years back.
zh: 所以你们会看到在底部,有四个平台,这是大概几年前的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the way we started was saying, we're going to extend out into what AIs need, right?
zh: 我们起步的方式是说,我们要扩展到 AI 所需要的东西,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So LLM AI APIs are APIs at the end of the day, but they need to be managed differently.
zh: 所以 LLM AI API 归根结底就是 API,但它们需要以不同的方式来管理。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we put an AI gateway in the API platform.
zh: 所以我们在 API 平台里放入了一个 AI 网关。

speaker: Unknown
en: The identity platform, we already know how to do very robust identity and access management for humans, so now let's do it for agents.
zh: 身份平台方面,我们已经很擅长为人类做非常强大的身份和访问管理,那么现在让我们为智能体做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Two, we added agent identity.
zh: 第二,我们添加了智能体身份。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was all last year, and this year we've released an agent platform that lets you use those things, but also lets you put it all together and manage the whole life cycle of these agents.
zh: 这些都是去年做的,而今年我们发布了一个智能体平台,让你可以使用这些东西,还能把它们全部整合起来,管理这些智能体的整个生命周期。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'll give a couple examples on the scientist side too.
zh: 所以我也举几个科学家方面的例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a small research group like I mentioned.
zh: 我们有一个像我提到过的小型研究团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm very proud we have these three publications this year.
zh: 我非常自豪我们今年有这三篇论文发表。

speaker: Unknown
en: Two of them are with undergrads in Sri Lanka.
zh: 其中两篇是和斯里兰卡的本科生合作的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is their first publication ever.
zh: 那是他们人生中的第一篇论文。

speaker: Unknown
en: And one of them won a best paper award.
zh: 而且其中一篇获得了最佳论文奖。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the architect side, right, the idea was AI is like great shiny object, but we want to infuse it in the whole digital fabric, so how can we extend that with these capabilities, like I mentioned before, so those are the things that we've added, and agent manager is the newest we've done, we've just released it.
zh: 在架构师方面,对吧,想法是 AI 就像很棒的闪亮新事物,但我们想把它注入到整个数字结构中,那么我们如何用这些能力来扩展它,就像我之前提到的,这些就是我们添加的东西,而智能体管理器是我们做的最新的东西,我们刚刚发布了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the interest of time, I won't step, but please feel free to explore the GitHub repo on the website.
zh: 为了节省时间,我就不一步步演示了,但请随时去网站上探索 GitHub 仓库。

speaker: Unknown
en: So just to close in a few more seconds, the idea is, okay, there's no silver bullet.
zh: 所以在最后几秒钟简单总结一下,想法是,好吧,没有银弹。

speaker: Unknown
en: Depends on the company.
zh: 这取决于公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to work very closely with others.
zh: 你必须和其他人非常紧密地合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I suggest if you try something like this, you have very strong backing and relationship with the CEO because you're going to have to work very closely with a lot of other parts of the company.
zh: 我建议,如果你尝试做类似这样的事情,你要有非常强大的支持以及和 CEO 的关系,因为你将不得不和公司里很多其他部门非常紧密地合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've seen also some places where if it's a very AI forward company, the chief AI officer, like the chief product officer and the chief AI officer are one person, right?
zh: 而且我也见过一些地方,如果是一家非常 AI 前瞻的公司,首席 AI 官,比如首席产品官和首席 AI 官是同一个人,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Or in other places that was surprising companies that are not software, I've also seen cases where the head of HR became the head of AI.
zh: 或者在其他地方,让我惊讶的是那些不是软件公司的公司,我也见过人力资源负责人变成 AI 负责人的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know how I feel about that, but yeah, I know.
zh: 我不知道我对此是什么感受,但是,是的,我知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, I'm okay.
zh: 我就是,我还行吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's just interesting things are happening.
zh: 所以有趣的事情正在发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone's trying to figure out what to do, right?
zh: 每个人都在试图弄清楚该做什么,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because they said, oh, agents are workforce.
zh: 因为他们说,哦,智能体是劳动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our workforce, so we manage them.
zh: 我们的劳动力,所以我们来管理它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: HR will manage them.
zh: HR 来管理它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: I appreciate that people feel like me in this room, because that rumor, I heard it, it was not the reaction.
zh: 我很感激这个房间里有人和我感受一样,因为那个传言,我听到了,那不是当时人们的反应。

speaker: Unknown
en: But so I'll just leave you with this to close.
zh: 但最后我就用这个来收尾。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I think about that, even for me, like, to take this role, I was trying to think, okay, you know, what I'm, somebody had given me this advice, like, think about what are you good at, and what do you love, what the world needs, and what you can be paid for, and try to find something at the intersection.
zh: 当我想到这个的时候,即使对我自己来说,比如,接下这个角色,我一直在想,好吧,你知道,有人给过我这个建议,比如,想想你擅长什么,你热爱什么,世界需要什么,以及你能靠什么获得报酬,然后试着找到它们的交集。

speaker: Unknown
en: So since this role is very fluid, still, try to find, if you're interested in it, and you're looking, you have a match somewhere, try to shape it in a way that you are at the center, and it makes you happy, and the things that you don't like, see if you can, like,
zh: 所以因为这个角色仍然非常流动,试着去寻找,如果你对它感兴趣,而且你在寻找,你在某处有一个匹配,试着把它塑造成你处于中心的方式,让你快乐,而那些你不喜欢的事情,看看你能不能,比如,

speaker: Unknown
en: Have someone work on them differently or maybe in different companies a better fit that has a better alignment with your interests, with your love and your needs and what you're good at.
zh: 让别人以不同的方式去做,或者也许在别的公司有更合适的,和你的兴趣、你的热爱、你的需求和你擅长的事情更契合的。

speaker: Unknown
en: All right.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have any questions, I'm around.
zh: 如果你们有任何问题,我就在附近。
